title: Quantity-Limited Drugs: Shortening of Non-Formulary Exception Approvals (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a quantity-limit review shortening is applied to a standard non-formulary exception approval for a drug that the member's review package under the Utilization Management Program limits. Two lists of that package are read: its quantity-limit list and its prior-authorization list.

| On the package's quantity-limit list | On the package's prior-authorization list | Taken off the approval period |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | **2** months |
| yes | no | **1** month |
| no | any | nothing |

The shortening is taken off the approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

*Hypothetical.* Take a drug the package both limits by quantity and subjects to prior authorization. 2 months are taken off, so a period that stood at 12 months becomes 10. If the drug were only quantity-limited it would become 11.
